correctness.rationale: The ten-vertex prism and all signed oriented matching faces are exhaustively specified. Exact rational chain boundary ranks 1,14,61,82,11 give rational Betti numbers 2 in degrees 2 and 3 and zero elsewhere. For each involution, signed eigen-basis finite-field boundary ranks add to exact rational full boundary ranks and therefore equal the rational eigen-ranks, proving their trace data. The rational C5 nontrivial irreducible has dimension four, forcing trivial rotation on both two-dimensional modules. Simultaneous eigenspace traces identify η⊕λ and 1⊕ηλ. A separate check enumerates all 20 group actions, boundary equivariance, and Lefschetz traces. Characteristic-zero transfer supplies quotient rational cohomology. Limits: no integral torsion or equivariant homotopy calculation.

value.rationale: The pentagonal prism is the natural closed five-rung analogue of the classical two-row grid matching problem. The two nonzero rational homology groups are both rank two but have inequivalent full automorphism representations. Their exact reflection/layer behavior shows that no degree-two invariant survives, whereas one degree-three class survives the full orbit quotient, an invariant not implied by ordinary Betti numbers or non-equivariant homotopy of open grids. This is a natural complete symmetry computation for a canonical small graph, not a parameter substitution or unexplained data-table entry.
